scan_metadata.explanation: Both filtered tutorials matched. They demonstrate one coherent workflow: list/choose a model, annotate a log1p-normalised (1e4) AnnData ('best match' or 'prob match', optional majority voting), export labels/probabilities, compare predictions with an existing label column (celltypist.dotplot, pd.crosstab, per-group probability boxplots), train a custom model from a labelled reference, and inspect a model's top driving genes. Duplicate demonstrations (built-in vs custom model, best vs prob match, two tutorials) were merged into 5 exposed tools across two modules: celltypist_tutorial owns 4 and celltypist_tutorial_ml owns 1. Model download, AnnData/table conversion, demo-data download and UMAP embedding plots are internal or omitted. Selecting a tool does not establish that it runs; the environment and execution stages decide that.

tutorials.title: Using CellTypist for cell type classification
tutorials.description: Annotates demo_2000_cells with the built-in Immune_All_Low.pkl model (best match + majority voting), converts results to AnnData, compares with the existing 'cell_type' column via celltypist.dotplot, trains a custom model on demo_2000_cells (feature_selection=True), predicts demo_400_cells with it, and inspects top driving genes (Mast cells) with violin plots.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Matches the explicit tutorial filter. Covers the core user tasks (model listing, annotation, reference comparison, training, marker inspection) on public Sanger-hosted demo data (demo_2000_cells, demo_400_cells).

suggested_tools.source_section: Assign cell type labels using a CellTypist built-in model (cells 15-20: models.models_description)
suggested_tools.description: List the available built-in CellTypist models and their descriptions from the CellTypist model index.
suggested_tools.outputs: Table of model filenames and descriptions (CSV + returned rows)

suggested_tools.source_section: Assign cell type labels using a CellTypist built-in model (cells 22-35) and Assign cell type labels using a custom model (cells 55-57); prob-match mode supported by celltypist_tutorial_ml cells 55-61, 77-78
suggested_tools.description: Annotate cells in a log1p-normalised (1e4) AnnData with a built-in or custom CellTypist model using best-match or probability-match (multi-label) mode, with optional majority voting; writes the annotated h5ad plus predicted-label, probability and decision tables.
suggested_tools.primary_input: h5ad path (log1p-normalised to 1e4 counts/cell in .X or .raw.X, gene symbols) + model name or .pkl path
suggested_tools.outputs: annotated.h5ad (predicted_labels, over_clustering, majority_voting, conf_score), predicted_labels.csv, probability_matrix.csv, decision_matrix.csv, label-frequency summary

suggested_tools.source_section: Assign cell type labels using a custom model (cells 48-54: celltypist.train, Model.write, Model.load)
suggested_tools.description: Train a custom CellTypist logistic-regression model from a labelled reference AnnData (optional SGD feature selection, optional random_state) and save it as a .pkl model.
suggested_tools.primary_input: h5ad path (log1p-normalised to 1e4) + obs label column name
suggested_tools.outputs: Absolute model .pkl path, model cell types, feature count, description

suggested_tools.source_section: Model meta information (cells 22-26) and Examine expression of cell type-driving genes (cells 61-68: Model.extract_top_markers, sc.pl.violin)
suggested_tools.description: Report a CellTypist model's metadata and cell types, extract the top driving genes per cell type, and optionally plot their expression in a user AnnData grouped by a chosen label column.
suggested_tools.primary_input: model name or .pkl path (+ optional h5ad path and groupby obs column)
suggested_tools.outputs: Model summary, markers table (cell_type, rank, gene), optional violin PNGs

tutorials.title: Using CellTypist for multi-label classification
tutorials.description: Annotates demo_500_cells (includes novel 'Microglia' and in-silico doublet 'Macro_pDC') with Immune_All_Low.pkl in 'best match' and 'prob match' (p_thres=0.5) modes with majority voting, inserts probabilities with to_adata(insert_prob=True), compares with 'cell_type' via pd.crosstab and celltypist.dotplot (predicted_labels and majority_voting), trains a custom model on demo_2000_cells, predicts demo_500 in prob-match mode, shows per-group probability boxplots, and extracts top driving genes (Macrophages).
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Matches the explicit tutorial filter. It is the only source that demonstrates multi-label 'prob match' mode, insert_prob, both use_as_prediction variants of the dotplot, the reference-vs-prediction crosstab, and the per-reference-group probability boxplots.
tutorials.figure_note: Cell 82 emits two PNGs (Microglia and Macro_pDC boxplots), so the notebook holds 11 PNG outputs in 10 cells.

suggested_tools.source_section: Single-label classification by finding the best match in the model (cells 47-51: pd.crosstab, celltypist.dotplot with predicted_labels and majority_voting) and Multi-label classification using a custom model (cells 78-83: per-group probability boxplots); dotplot also in celltypist_tutorial cells 41, 60
suggested_tools.description: Compare CellTypist predictions (predicted_labels or majority_voting) from celltypist_annotate_cells with an existing reference label/cluster column: label-transfer dot plot with its fraction and mean-probability tables, a reference-by-prediction crosstab, and optional probability boxplots for selected reference groups.
suggested_tools.primary_input: celltypist_annotate_cells output directory + reference obs column name (+ optional reference groups for probability boxplots)
suggested_tools.outputs: Dot-plot PNG, dot fraction and mean-probability CSVs, crosstab CSV, optional per-group probability boxplot PNGs
